instruction: A warehouse starts with 2388 boxes. It receives several deliveries of 62 boxes each. It ships 199 boxes per day for 6 days. How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
